title: 第324章 来自未来的人第323章 破防破大防
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
第324章来自未来的人
破防前世在大学图书馆里读过大变革之前的史料，在虚拟影像里见过那些被复原出来的历史场景。
他以为自己很了解这个时代，以为自己手握剧本，以为自己是天选之人，可以在这个风起云涌的时代里混得风生水起。
所以他穿越过来之后，第一时间就找上了真如寺。
不是他有多虔诚，是因为他知道，这座此时还不算特别显眼的中寺，将来会是整个玄国最强的势力之一。
他要在真如寺还没有起飞的时候，绑上这艘大船。
几年前的拈花大会开始前。
破防站在山门外，仰头看着真如寺的匾额，心中五味杂陈。
在后世的记忆里，这座山门金碧辉煌，可此刻，却略显寒酸。
更让他意外的，是真如寺在中寺里的排名。
他前世读到过，真如寺在大变革之前就已经是中寺里的佼佼者了。
但他没想到，这个“佼佼者”的水分这么大。
寺内明面上的最强战力不过是抱丹后期方丈真恒和一直闭关的蕴丹期老祖两个人撑起了全寺的门面。
这跟他想象中的“准顶级势力”差得太远了。
他原以为真如寺至少有几个蕴丹期坐镇，结果有些出乎意料。
当然也有可能是隐藏实力，只是他自己不知道。
可他还是进来了。
毕竟他从史料里知道，真如寺的转折点就在这几年。
灵气复苏、门派扩张、人才辈出，所有这些变化都会在接下来的几年里集中爆发。
他要做的，就是在这趟飞驰的列车上抢到一个靠窗的位置。

他拜在了如悔门下。
如悔是真悟师伯的弟子，化劲后期的修为，在如字辈中稳居第一。
破防对这个师父很满意。
话不多，做事踏实，从不苛责弟子，也从不过分溺爱。
他给破防的指导，每一次都在点子上；
他给破防的丹药，每一粒都是自己省下来的。
破防有时候会想，如果后世的历史书上有一页是写如悔的，那一定是一行很小的字，小到没有人会注意到。
但在他心里，师父的分量重得不能再重。
刚才他收到雁门关大捷消息的时候，整个人都懵了。
脑子里翻来覆去地过那些他以为永远不会错的记忆，一遍又一遍，像一台卡了带的播放器。
不对两个字在他心里循环往复了好几百遍。
然后他忽然想通了。
站起身的那一刻，膝盖“咔咔”响了两声。
当他推开窗户时，夜风灌进来，让他精神一振。
他不应该执着于那些记忆的真假。
记忆是真的，只不过这方天地没有按他的记忆走。
记忆中的历史书里写的“决战雁门”是燕国赢了，那只是记忆。
可他此刻站在这里，站在真如寺的后院里，呼吸着真实的空气，感受着真实的风，身边是真实的师兄弟，头顶是真实的月亮。
这一切都在告诉他，历史书是死的，世界是活的。
活的东西，不会照着死的东西走。
content_en:
Chapter 324 The Man from the Future
In her previous life, Po Feng had read historical materials before the Great Revolution in the university library, and had seen the restored historical scenes in virtual images.
He thought he understood this era very well, thought he had the script in hand, and thought he was the chosen one who could prosper in this turbulent era.
So after he traveled through time, he immediately found Zhenru Temple.
It's not that he is very pious, but because he knows that this middle temple, which is not particularly conspicuous at this time, will be one of the strongest forces in the entire Xuan Kingdom in the future.
He wanted to tie up the big ship before Zhenru Temple took off.
Before the Flower Nian Conference started a few years ago.
Po Fang stood outside the mountain gate, looking up at the plaque of Zhenru Temple, with mixed feelings in his heart.
In the memory of later generations, this mountain gate is magnificent, but at this moment, it looks a little shabby.
What surprised him even more was Zhenru Temple's ranking among the middle temples.
He had read in his previous life that Zhenru Temple was already a leader in the middle temple before the great changes.
But he didn't expect that this "best person" would be so wet.
The most powerful force in the temple is only Zhen Heng, the abbot of the late Baodan period, and the ancestor of the Yundan period who has been in seclusion, supporting the facade of the whole temple.
This was far from the "quasi-top power" he imagined.
He originally thought that Zhenru Temple would have at least a few Yundan periods in charge, but the result was somewhat unexpected.
Of course, it is also possible that he is hiding his strength, but he just doesn't know it.
But he came in anyway.
After all, he knew from historical data that the turning point of Zhenru Temple was in these few years.
The revival of spiritual energy, the expansion of sects, and the emergence of talents. All these changes will explode in the next few years.
All he had to do was grab a window seat on this speeding train.
He worshiped Ruhui's disciples.
Ruhui is a disciple of Master Zhenwu, and his cultivation in the late stage of Huajin ranks first among Ruzi's generation.
Po Fang was very satisfied with this master.
He doesn't talk much but is practical in his work. He never criticizes his disciples harshly and never overly dotes on them.
His guidance on breaking defenses was on point every time;
Every pill he gave to break the defense was saved by himself.
Po Fang sometimes thinks that if there is a page written about Ru Rui in the history books of later generations, it must be a very small line of words, so small that no one will notice it.
But in his heart, the weight of Master could not be heavier.
When he received the news of the great victory at Yanmen Pass just now, he was completely stunned.
The memories that he thought would never be wrong went over and over in his mind, over and over again, like a stuck player.
The word "wrong" recurred in his mind hundreds of times.
Then it suddenly dawned on him.
The moment I stood up, my knees made two "clicks".
When he opened the window, the night breeze came in, refreshing him.
He shouldn't be obsessed with the authenticity of those memories.
The memory is true, but this world does not follow his memory.
The "Decisive Battle of Yanmen" written in the history books in my memory is that Yan won, but that is just a memory.
But now he is standing here, standing in the backyard of Zhenru Temple, breathing the real air, feeling the real wind, surrounded by real brothers, and with the real moon above his head.
All this tells him that history books are dead and the world is alive.
Living things will not follow the footsteps of dead things.
